summary.en-US: Fill CUIMS login details, solve the CAPTCHA on-device, skip promotional interstitials, hide event or feedback interruptions, and open a cleaner LMS course directory.

version.approval_notes: CUIMS Clear is an independent student utility. It stores credentials only in Firefox storage.local. CAPTCHA images are read on-device by the extension's own unminified JavaScript (captcha-solver.js), which matches the four characters against the glyphs of the fixed font CUIMS uses (captcha-glyphs.js, generated by scripts/build-captcha-glyphs.py in the source repository); no data is uploaded and no remote code is loaded at runtime. Since 0.8.6 there is no third-party or minified code in the package. Host access is limited to students.cuchd.in and lms.cuchd.in. The LMS launcher clicks the university's own CU LMS control and follows the LMS URL without saving it. The LMS directory may fetch additional same-origin /my/courses.php pages to pair syllabus and semester-work entries.
